title: Secrets of Magic 3: Happy Halloween
description: Match your way through this fun and phantasmal adventure game, overcome tough obstacles, use power ups to help you win gold to buy amazing Halloween decoration items and unlock new items as you progress in your game. Are you up for this spooky challenge? Features: Get into the Halloween mood with this clever match 3 game Fun gameplay with tons of challenge levels Plan your moves, race against time or play it relaxed Enjoy a variety of game modes and difficulty modes Collect gold to buy Halloween decoration items Tough obstacles and cool power ups
